description: A 60-second arithmetic sprint — adaptive difficulty that ramps up as your streak grows.

faqs.a: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with whole-number answers.
Every 5-in-a-row streak raises the level: bigger numbers, times tables, division, then negatives.
Each correct answer scores 10 × your level; a wrong answer resets the streak.
You get 60 seconds from pressing Start. Answer as many as you can!
faqs.q: How long does a round last?

howto: Type the answer and press Enter.
Chain correct answers to raise the difficulty level.
Wrong answers reset your streak — keep it alive!
title: Math Quiz Game
